name: Houzuki Noeru
source:
A girl who looks cute, but is blunt and stern.
She doesn't talk much, and when she does, she talks bluntly and without tact, which may hurts other.
A serious girl who is not good at socialization.
She tries to change her character, but is unable to open up to anyone.

As an output for her frustrations, she has been distributing videos using her avatar on the internet without telling anyone. There she acts her ideal image of a 'Bright and Cheerful girl'
